# Get-SecureScoreReport

<!-- Generated by tools/Build-Catalog.ps1. Edit the script header, not this file. -->

Reports the tenant's current Microsoft Secure Score, optionally with a per-control and per-category breakdown.

| | |
|---|---|
| Location | `scripts/windows/m365/Get-SecureScoreReport.ps1` |
| Platform | Windows (PowerShell 5.1+ with Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK) |
| Permissions | Graph scopes SecurityEvents.Read.All, Organization.Read.All (Security Reader or Global Reader) |
| Safety | Read-only |

## When to use

Security posture review, baseline before a hardening project, or quarterly progress reporting.

## Description

Reads the latest Microsoft Secure Score from the Microsoft Graph (beta) security API and writes an HTML
report with the tenant name, the current and maximum score and percentage. With -IncludeControlScores it also reads the
Secure Score control profiles, calculates the percentage achieved per control, averages them per category,
and lists the 50 lowest-scoring controls with their state and tier. An optional CSV contains the per-control
data (only available with -IncludeControlScores). This script is read-only. If no score data is returned,
no report is written.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-OutputPath` | String | No | Folder for the report. Falls back to $env:TOOLBOX_REPORT_DIR, then prompts. |
| `-CustomerName` | String | No | Optional. Adds a &lt;OutputPath&gt;\&lt;CustomerName&gt; subfolder. |
| `-ExportCsv` | SwitchParameter | No | Also write the per-control data to a CSV. Only effective together with -IncludeControlScores. |
| `-IncludeControlScores` | SwitchParameter | No | Include per-control and per-category results in the report. |
| `-SkipGraphConnect` | SwitchParameter | No | Skip Connect-MgGraph (use when a Graph session with suitable scopes already exists). |

## Examples

```powershell
.\Get-SecureScoreReport.ps1 -OutputPath D:\Reports
```

```powershell
.\Get-SecureScoreReport.ps1 -OutputPath D:\Reports -CustomerName Contoso -IncludeControlScores -ExportCsv
```
